headline: 侠探杰克登顶热议，多部新片本周上映
headlineEn: Jack Reacher tops trending as new films hit this week
summary: 今日娱乐热搜由《侠探杰克》领跑，《小黄人与大怪兽》《奥德赛》紧随其后；《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》稳居本周趋势榜首。本周共有6部新片上映，今日无新片。待映项目包括《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》。
summaryEn: Jack Reacher leads today's trending, followed by Minions & Monsters and The Odyssey, while Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops the weekly chart. Six new films arrive this week; none today. Upcoming include Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共有6部新片与观众见面。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies open today; six new titles hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》登顶本周趋势榜。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops this week's trending list.

industryHighlights.text: 《奥德赛》《青年华盛顿》等新作持续受关注。
industryHighlights.en: The Odyssey and Young Washington remain in the spotlight.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》列入待映片单。
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are on the upcoming slate.
